lines.x: The Central Bank of West African States (BCEAO) has scheduled its fourth ordinary meeting of the Monetary Policy Committee for December 2, 2026, in Senegal.
Senegal's president bypassed parliament to move forward with a $2.2 billion IMF bailout program as public-sector debt reached an estimated 132% of GDP at the end of 2024.
Senegal's Treasury raised 55 billion CFA francs at its November 20, 2026 auction on the regional securities market.
Senegal's National Assembly rejected the initial 2027 finance bill on 18 November 2026.
